fields.name: banner
fields.label: Orange banner
fields.description: Three paragraphs. 1: the rate in bold, then a few words, e.g. 9.75%* p.a. onwards. 2: the description text. 3: the button link.

fields.name: leftTable
fields.label: Left table
fields.description: Heading 3, then one bulleted list. First bullet = column headings (bold label, then the second heading). Other bullets = rows: bold label, then the value. Write a value in italic to show it as a green pill (Nil). A bullet with only italic text is a group heading row.

fields.name: rightTable
fields.label: Right table
fields.description: Heading 3, an optional note paragraph, then one bulleted list. Same rules as the left table.
